builds.summary: Each feather has 110+.4 AD[statFormula=2] times explicit .5 crit-stat factor. Fix seven feathers from Q+R and measure recall attenuation rather than invent unlimited feathers.
builds.goal: Each feather has 110+.4 AD[statFormula=2] times explicit .5 crit-stat factor. Fix seven feathers from Q+R and measure recall attenuation rather than invent unlimited feathers.
builds.hypothesis:
Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing [(50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.5) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage each. If [3] or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for [1.25] seconds.
Bloodthirster supplies 80 AD; Infinity Edge/Collector/Essence Reaver/LDR provide crit/AD for the explicitly stated crit interaction; LDR penetrates armor, Profane supplies AD/lethality. Spellblade/on-hits are separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Prepare exactly seven feathers behind target, E once, log all hits/attenuation; setup spell damage excluded. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Rune reasoning: Xayah — Bladecaller: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing [(50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.5) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage each. If [3] or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for [1.25] seconds. Bloodthir Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Essence Reaver, The Collector, Profane Hydra. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
